## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if one exists.

## Verification

List the commands run and the results. For parsing changes, include a small sanitized example or a regression test.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented where needed.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, or this is a documentation-only change.
- [ ] Fixtures and examples contain no private reports or real secrets.
- [ ] Any new fixture identifies its runner/version or is labeled synthetic.
